name: Financial Assistance For Renovation And Special Repair Works To Hindu Religious Institutions Situated In Economically Weaker Section Areas / Adi-Dravidar Colonies
benefit: One-time financial assistance to the tune of ₹2,50,000/- per temple towards the purchase of building materials for renovation and special repair works.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be the concerned temple authority. - The applicant must represent a temple that is not coming under the purview of the Department of Hindu Religious Institutions. - The applicant must represent a temple situated in Adi-Dravidar colonies or Economically Weaker Section Areas.
